execution_notes: A preliminary runner invocation stopped in the reporting layer while converting the power map to original units (Python list/scalar type mismatch); it produced no archived result or acceptance record and no DUT/oracle mismatch was reported.
The reporting conversion was corrected. The complete 11-case run then finished with exit code 0 and all acceptance checks true. The final evidence and hashes below refer only to that completed run.

Post-run evidence normalization: the initial result report applied an extra 1/8 factor to the Float FFT diagnostic. The archived Float FFT outputs were rescaled by 8 to original-amplitude units and the diagnostic MAX/RMS values recalculated from the already archived Float/Fixed arrays. Exact Q1.15 input codes were materialized from the archived Float IQ using the approved C03 input-pack oracle; Float/Fixed cluster-peak coordinate equality was checked against the archived cluster records. No signal-chain or oracle campaign was rerun for these report/archive corrections.
